pages.text: A wand commonly used by Dersites. As a mace.$(br2)$(3)$(l)Special:$() Gives Invisibility for 10 seconds (20 seconds for Void players) when used, and can be turned into an Amethyst Backstabber by using it while holding shift.

A wand commonly used by Dersites. As a mace.$(br2)$(3)$(l)Special:$() Increases speed by 15% while casting, ender spell power by 20%, and can be turned into an Amethyst Backstabber by using it while holding shift (does not work with a spellbook equipped).
